content: Yeneen nominasiyoŋ yi ñu fa defar mooy Film bi gën a rafet, Rëddkat bi (Réalisateur), Foto bi (Cinématographie), Defar yi ñuy sol (Costume), Dëgg-dëgg film bi (Montage), Ndaw-ndawal musig bi (Original Score), Defar bi ñuy defar film bi (Production Design), Defar kaaraange baat (Sound Editing), Boole baat yi (Sound Mixing) ak Léebu film bu njëkk (Original Screenplay).
